coverage_scope: Top-level README and ROADMAP claim anchors only. This is not a complete semantic verifier for every documentation sentence.

claims.claim_summary: LibreEvolve is alpha-stage, local, Python-first research code and not a production optimizer or full AlphaEvolve reproduction.

README runnable-today bullets describe Python-primary workspaces, SEARCH/REPLACE mutations, configured provider backends, local MAP-Elites/island archives, local evaluation, hooks, and runs/ artifacts.

README important limits keep AlphaEvolve-scale benchmarks, Google/Gemini parity, distributed async topology, arbitrary language runners, hardened sandboxing, and paper-cache claims scoped as missing or non-proof evidence.
ROADMAP current-state bullets are maintained planning summaries whose authoritative evidence remains code, tests, runtime artifacts, paper sidecars, and TODO ledgers.
ROADMAP documentation-truthfulness status records path, manifest, TODO-coverage, and sidecar-registry guards while leaving semantic claim-by-claim proof open.
ROADMAP missing-work sections preserve AlphaEvolve parity gaps instead of treating local validators, sidecars, or fixtures as full paper-result reproduction.

claim_boundary: This inventory gives stable ids and evidence anchors for the top-level README and ROADMAP AlphaEvolve-facing status claims. It does not claim complete README coverage, complete ROADMAP coverage, semantic claim verification, stale completed-entry detection, generated alignment reports, or full proof that every documentation claim is current.
